data.body: Validation update: full make verify with PYTEST_WORKERS=2 completed lint/typecheck and ran the full pytest selection, but failed one unrelated interface test with 'git commit failed while holding lock: git timed out after 30s' during xdist execution after ~1h54m. The exact failed test, tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py::test_scan_epics_executes_prompt_from_configured_snapshot, passed solo with the required GIT_CONFIG_* unset environment (1 passed in 254.27s), so I am treating the full-suite failure as host/test-runner contention rather than a product regression from this change.
